ads_ratio.reason: 20-F filer: engine per-share figures are per ordinary share while the traded price ($8.63) is per ADS; the ratio scales OE/share x2 onto the ADS basis.
ads_ratio.source: FY2025 Form 20-F (filed 2026-04-17), notes to the consolidated financial statements, EPS note: 'One ADS represents two Class A ordinary shares of the Company' (also Note 1.1: 'Each ADS of the Company represents two ordinary shares')

moat_against: No exclusive catalog lock-in since the 2021 SAMR ruling — rivals license the same music
ByteDance (Soda Music) and NetEase Cloud Music competition for listening time
Social entertainment services in structural decline (-16.4% YoY in Q2 2026) under regulatory pressure
Measured ROIC only ~9-13% in recent years — solid, not wide-moat
moat_for: Dominant share of China online music (QQ Music, Kugou, Kuwo) plus WeSing
Tencent controlling shareholder — WeChat/QQ ecosystem distribution and promotion
Major-label and proprietary content relationships; SVIP tier raising per-user monetization
Ximalaya acquisition (closed May 18, 2026) extends the moat into long-form audio
Fortress balance sheet: RMB44.22B cash, term deposits and short-term investments (Jun 30, 2026), negligible borrowings
moat_justification: China's dominant online music platform (QQ Music, Kugou, Kuwo, WeSing) with Tencent as controlling shareholder and ecosystem distribution, major-label content relationships, a fast-growing SVIP subscription tier and, since May 2026, Ximalaya in long-form audio. Gross margin expanded from 30.1% (2021) to 42.3% (2024) and 44.2% in Q2 2026 as the mix shifted to subscriptions; roic_proxy rose from 6.8% (2021) to 12.6% (2024) — above the cost of capital and rising, but not the sustained mid-teens-plus of a wide moat, and the proxy denominator excludes most of the RMB44.2B cash/term-deposit/short-term-investment pile, so measured ROIC understates the franchise somewhat. Capped at 6: catalogs are licensable by rivals (the 2021 SAMR ruling ended exclusive licensing), ByteDance's Soda Music and NetEase Cloud Music compete for the same users, and social entertainment is in structural/regulatory decline.
name: Tencent Music Entertainment Group
one_liner: High-quality net-cash China music leader, moat 6/10 — but $8.63/ADS does not clear 15%: weighted IRR 11.7% on the normalized base (weighted IV@15% $6.19); even the latest-FY base reaches only 14.7%. Clears 15% at ~$6.19/ADS or below.
